review_reference: Backend releases backend-39893314723-1-d9bc36aeb69af7f4 (W03, D-Eminence/hid-system#103 at d92b696, deployed 2026-10-23 03:56 UTC with status success for all 12 services) and backend-39897903246-1-cc1125ef8cd7026f (W04, #104 at 15789f7, 04:10 UTC, identity-api only). Browser-facing changes since 2556260: W03 binds patient-self reads to the patient's live session (the portal's own sessions keep reading); W04 answers every refused sign-in credential with 401 'Invalid credentials', a Google session refusal with 401 GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_DENIED, Turnstile configuration errors with 503 TURNSTILE_UNAVAILABLE and a missing token with 400 TURNSTILE_REQUIRED, accepts staff-reset on app.healthidentitydirectory.com, and drops patientId from the access-request create answer. This frontend shows those refusals' messages and reads only accessRequestId and status from the create answer (staff/routes/Patients.tsx).
